items.title: NVIDIA Releases TensorRT Model Connect in Public Preview: Hugging Face Checkpoint to Native C++ Inference in Two Commands
items.summary: NVIDIA has released TensorRT Model Connect (TRTMC) in public preview, an Apache-2.0 project that takes a supported Hugging Face or local checkpoint to end-to-end TensorRT inference in two commands, with no intermediate ONNX export. The build emits a versioned .bundle artifact that runs through native C++ task APIs, so inference executes without PyTorch in the runtime path. NVIDIA's July 29, 2026 GB300 snapshot covers 105 release profiles across 76 model families. The post NVIDIA Releases TensorRT Model Connect in Public Preview: Hugging Face Checkpoint to Native C++ Inference in Two Commands appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: 輝達 已釋出 TensorRT Model Connect (TRTMC) 公共預覽版，這是一個 Apache-2.0 專案，它採用受支援的 Hugging Face 或本地檢查點，透過兩個命令進行端到端 TensorRT 推理，無需中間 ONNX 匯出。該構建會發出一個版本化的 .bundle 工件，該工件透過本機 C++ 任務 API 執行，因此在執行時路徑中無需 PyTorch 即可執行推理。 輝達的 2026 年 7 月 29 日 GB300 快照涵蓋 76 個型號系列的 105 個版本配置檔案。 輝達 釋出 TensorRT 模型連線公共預覽版：Hugging Face 檢查點到兩個命令中的本機 C++ 推理一文首先出現在 MarkTechPost 上。

items.title: OpenAI says it's "pacing model development" as AI cybersecurity risks grow too dangerous
items.summary: OpenAI is deliberately "pacing AI model development," partly because the upcoming "Astra" model may be close to gaining critical cyberattack capabilities. A new monitoring system triggers an alert within 30 minutes if a model shows suspicious behavior. The article OpenAI says it's "pacing model development" as AI cybersecurity risks grow too dangerous appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 有意“加快人工智慧模型開發速度”，部分原因是即將推出的“Astra”模型可能即將獲得關鍵的網路攻擊能力。如果模型表現出可疑行為，新的監控系統會在 30 分鐘內觸發警報。文章 OpenAI 表示，隨著人工智慧網路安全風險變得過於危險，它正在“調整模型開發”，該文章首先出現在 The Decoder 上。

items.summary: Artificial Analysis has released the "Search Index," a benchmark that rates search API providers for AI agents on quality, cost, and speed. The article New benchmark ranks search APIs for AI agents on quality, cost, and speed appeared first on The Decoder .

items.title: Meet SAM (Sovereign Agent Mesh): A Zero-Config, Zero-Trust P2P Network for AI Agents
items.summary: Google has open-sourced SAM (Sovereign Agent Mesh) under Apache-2.0 — and it has nothing to do with Segment Anything. SAM is a zero-config, zero-trust P2P overlay that lets autonomous agents discover and call each other's MCP tools across cloud, on-prem, laptop and edge environments, without exposing a single internal endpoint to the public internet. Identity flows from OIDC into Biscuit capability tokens, so nodes authorize every request offline under a strict default-deny model. The post Meet SAM (Sovereign Agent Mesh): A Zero-Config, Zero-Trust P2P Network for AI Agents appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: Google 在 Apache-2.0 下開源了 SAM（主權代理網格）——它與 Segment Anything 無關。 SAM 是一種零配置、零信任的 P2P 覆蓋層，允許自主代理跨雲、本地、膝上型電腦和邊緣環境發現並呼叫彼此的 MCP 工具，而無需將單個內部端點暴露到公共網際網路。身份從 OIDC 流入 Biscuit 功能令牌，因此節點在嚴格的預設拒絕模型下離線授權每個請求。認識 SAM（主權代理網格）：用於 AI 代理的零配置、零信任 P2P 網路首先出現在 MarkTechPost 上。

items.title: Anthropic CEO says AI centralizes by nature and open models just shift power to whoever owns the chips
items.summary: An open fight over AI regulation has broken out on X. Investor Gavin Baker, former White House adviser David Sacks, and Meta researcher Yann LeCun accuse Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei of using fear rhetoric to buy himself a regulatory advantage. Amodei counters that regulation can also rein in corporate power, and that open models alone just shift power toward the players with the most computing muscle. The article Anthropic CEO says AI centralizes by nature and open models just shift power to whoever owns the chips appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: X 上爆發了一場關於人工智慧監管的公開鬥爭。投資者 Gavin Baker、前白宮顧問 David Sacks 和 Meta 研究員 Yann LeCun 指責 Anthropic 執行長 Dario Amodei 使用恐懼言論為自己贏得監管優勢。阿莫代反駁說，監管也可以限制企業權力，而開放模型本身只會將權力轉移給擁有最強計算能力的參與者。 Anthropic 執行長表示人工智慧本質上是中心化的，開放模型只是將權力轉移給擁有晶片的人，該文章首先出現在 The Decoder 上。

items.title: As AI beats doctors, regulators shouldn't force a human into the loop, JAMA piece says
items.summary: An opinion piece in the medical journal JAMA argues that autonomous AI will soon outperform any doctor-AI team at medical reasoning tasks. The authors warn against writing a doctor's final say into regulation, but concede that almost all the evidence comes from simulations, not real patient care. The article As AI beats doctors, regulators shouldn't force a human into the loop, JAMA piece says appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 醫學雜誌《美國醫學會雜誌》上的一篇評論文章認為，自主人工智慧很快就會在醫學推理任務上超越任何醫生人工智慧團隊。作者警告不要將醫生的最終決定權寫入監管，但承認幾乎所有證據都來自模擬，而不是真正的患者護理。 《JAMA》文章稱，《人工智慧擊敗醫生，監管機構不應強迫人類進入循環》一文首先出現在《解碼器》上。

items.title: DOJ probes Andreessen Horowitz over partners sitting on competing AI boards
items.summary: Andreessen Horowitz is the focus of an antitrust probe by the US Justice Department. The charge is that the firm's partners sit on the boards of competing data firms Databricks and Fivetran at the same time. The venture capital firm's close ties to the Trump administration add a twist, since it has actively lobbied for the administration's AI deregulation. The article DOJ probes Andreessen Horowitz over partners sitting on competing AI boards appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 安德森霍洛維茨是美國司法部反壟斷調查的焦點。指控是該公司的合夥人同時擔任競爭資料公司 Databricks 和 Fivetran 的董事會成員。這家風險投資公司與特朗普政府的密切關係增添了一些曲折，因為它一直積極遊說政府放鬆對人工智慧的管制。美國司法部調查安德森·霍洛維茨 (Andreessen Horowitz) 的文章首先出現在 The Decoder 上。

items.title: Anthropic's per-token cost runs 4.4 times the average on Vercel, and developers keep paying
items.summary: Anthropic dominated Vercel's AI Gateway spending in July, pulling in 65.1 percent of total revenue while accounting for only 30 percent of tokens processed. Its tokens cost 4.4 times as much as those from competing providers on average. The article Anthropic's per-token cost runs 4.4 times the average on Vercel, and developers keep paying appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 在 7 月份主導了 Vercel 的 AI 閘道器支出，佔總收入的 65.1%，但僅佔處理的代幣的 30%。其代幣價格平均是競爭對手的 4.4 倍。文章《Anthropic's 每個代幣成本是 Vercel 上平均成本的 4.4 倍，開發人員繼續付費》首先出現在 The Decoder 上。

items.title: Cartesia Ships Sonic-3.6: A Streaming TTS Model That Now Leads Both Artificial Analysis Speech Arenas
items.summary: Cartesia has released Sonic-3.6, a streaming text-to-speech model built on state space models rather than transformers. It now ranks #1 on both Artificial Analysis speech leaderboards — 1,283 Elo on Provider Voice and 1,123 on Controlled Voice, the board that clones every model onto the same eight reference voices to isolate the synthesis engine. Cartesia states sub-90ms time-to-first-audio. The model is available in beta on Cartesia's own API The post Cartesia Ships Sonic-3.6: A Streaming TTS Model That Now Leads Both Artificial Analysis Speech Arenas appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: Cartesia 釋出了 Sonic-3.6，這是一種基於狀態空間模型而不是 Transformer 構建的流式文字到語音模型。現在，它在人工分析語音排行榜上均排名第一，在 Provider Voice 上排名 1,283 Elo，在 Controlled Voice 上排名 1,123，該排行榜將每個模型克隆到相同的八個參考語音上以隔離合成引擎。 Cartesia 表示首個音訊的時間低於 90 毫秒。該模型已在 Cartesia 自己的 API 上提供測試版。Cartesia 釋出了 Sonic-3.6：目前引領人工分析語音競技場的流式 TTS 模型，該模型首先出現在 MarkTechPost 上。

items.title: Claude Code gets a /design command that lets developers create UI mockups right in the terminal
items.summary: With the /design command, Anthropic brings a visual design workflow directly into Claude Code. Developers can generate UI mockups as artboards right in the terminal before writing any code. Claude reads the existing codebase and matches the current UI style. The article Claude Code gets a /design command that lets developers create UI mockups right in the terminal appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 透過 /design 命令，Anthropic 將視覺化設計工作流程直接引入 Claude Code。開發人員可以在編寫任何程式碼之前在終端中生成 UI 模型作為畫板。 Claude 讀取現有的程式碼庫並匹配當前的 UI 風格。文章 Claude Code 獲取 /design 命令，讓開發人員可以直接在終端中建立 UI 模型，該文章首先出現在 The Decoder 上。

items.title: AI systems quietly drop user instructions when they compress context
items.summary: When AI systems condense long conversations, they drop an average of 83 percent of user rules, like "don't send emails without my approval." Penn State researchers propose a small add-on module built on Qwen3.5-9B that preserves over 90 percent of these restrictions. The article AI systems quietly drop user instructions when they compress context appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 當人工智慧系統壓縮長對話時，它們平均會放棄 83% 的使用者規則，例如“未經我批准，請勿傳送電子郵件”。賓夕法尼亞州立大學的研究人員提出了一個基於 Qwen3.5-9B 構建的小型附加模組，該模組保留了 90% 以上的限制。文章《人工智慧系統在壓縮上下文時悄悄地丟棄使用者指令》首先出現在 The Decoder 上。

items.summary: Anthropic's annualized revenue has topped $65 billion, a sevenfold increase in one year, according to Bloomberg. The company could go public as early as fall 2026 at a $1 trillion valuation, potentially beating OpenAI to market. The article Anthropic increases revenue sevenfold, hits annualized rate above $65 billion appeared first on The Decoder .

items.title: 地熱電廠導入5G AI-RAN專網，結合AI提升巡檢效率20%、夏季發電效率增5%
items.summary: AI應用、資料中心與高科技製造持續增加用電需求，發展穩定的低碳電力成為國內推動能源轉型的重要課題，其中運用地熱發電是一個重要的低碳電力來源，位於新北市金山的四磺子坪及硫磺子兩座地熱發電廠近期匯入5G AI-RAN專網、Edge AI、AIoT與生成式AI維運等技術。地熱電廠匯入機器狗智慧巡檢、能源最佳化分析及生成式AI維運系統 ，巡檢效率提高逾20%，夏季發電效率提升5%以上，建立國內綠能發電智慧維運管理的應用案例。 這項計畫由臺灣大哥大與將捷集團旗下結元能源開發合作推動，在國發會「AI+產業智慧共創實證計畫－AI服務大平臺整合次世代通訊之生態共創服務計畫」支援之下進行，希望驗證AI結合5G通訊在綠能發電場域的應用成效，建立可複製的智慧能源維運模式。

items.title: Nous Research Ships Bot Mode for Hermes Agent, Turning Agent Profiles Into a Roster of Named Bots
items.summary: Nous Research has shipped Bot Mode for Hermes Agent, its MIT-licensed open source agent. Bot Mode replaces the single-agent session list with a roster of named bots. Each bot is a real Hermes profile, with its own chat, memory, skills, and pinned model. It is now bundled and default-on in Hermes Desktop. The post Nous Research Ships Bot Mode for Hermes Agent, Turning Agent Profiles Into a Roster of Named Bots appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: Nous Research 已經為 Hermes Agent 提供了 Bot 模式，Hermes Agent 是其 MIT 許可的開源代理。機器人模式用指定機器人名冊取代單代理會話列表。每個機器人都是真正的 Hermes 個人資料，具有自己的聊天、記憶、技能和固定模型。它現在已捆綁並在 Hermes Desktop 中預設開啟。 Nous Research 為 Hermes Agent 提供 Bot 模式，將 Agent 配置檔案轉化為命名機器人名冊，該文章首先出現在 MarkTechPost 上。

items.title: ByteDance Seed and Tsinghua AIR Introduces CUDA Agent: A Large-Scale Agentic RL System for CUDA Kernel Generation
items.summary: ByteDance Seed and Tsinghua AIR have released CUDA Agent, an agentic reinforcement learning system that trains a large language model to write GPU kernels that beat a compiler. The gap it targets is narrow but stubborn: frontier models already produce correct CUDA, they just produce slow CUDA. On KernelBench, the base model Seed1.6 passes 74.0% […] The post ByteDance Seed and Tsinghua AIR Introduces CUDA Agent: A Large-Scale Agentic RL System for CUDA Kernel Generation appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: 位元組跳動 Seed 和清華大學 AIR 釋出了 CUDA Agent，這是一種代理強化學習系統，可以訓練大型語言模型來編寫擊敗編譯器的 GPU 核心。它的目標差距雖小但很頑固：前沿模型已經產生了正確的 CUDA，但它們只是產生了緩慢的 CUDA。在 KernelBench 上，基本模型 Seed1.6 透過了 74.0% […] 位元組跳動 Seed 和清華 AIR 推出 CUDA Agent：用於 CUDA 核心生成的大規模代理 RL 系統的帖子首先出現在 MarkTechPost 上。

Qwen 3.8 27B is a truly astonishing model . Via Hacker News Tags: ai , generative-ai , llms , qwen , ai-in-china , artificial-analysis

items_ai.title: NVIDIA Releases TensorRT Model Connect in Public Preview: Hugging Face Checkpoint to Native C++ Inference in Two Commands
items_ai.summary: NVIDIA has released TensorRT Model Connect (TRTMC) in public preview, an Apache-2.0 project that takes a supported Hugging Face or local checkpoint to end-to-end TensorRT inference in two commands, with no intermediate ONNX export. The build emits a versioned .bundle artifact that runs through native C++ task APIs, so inference executes without PyTorch in the runtime path. NVIDIA's July 29, 2026 GB300 snapshot covers 105 release profiles across 76 model families. The post NVIDIA Releases TensorRT Model Connect in Public Preview: Hugging Face Checkpoint to Native C++ Inference in Two Commands appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_ai.summary_zh: 輝達 已釋出 TensorRT Model Connect (TRTMC) 公共預覽版，這是一個 Apache-2.0 專案，它採用受支援的 Hugging Face 或本地檢查點，透過兩個命令進行端到端 TensorRT 推理，無需中間 ONNX 匯出。該構建會發出一個版本化的 .bundle 工件，該工件透過本機 C++ 任務 API 執行，因此在執行時路徑中無需 PyTorch 即可執行推理。 輝達的 2026 年 7 月 29 日 GB300 快照涵蓋 76 個型號系列的 105 個版本配置檔案。 輝達 釋出 TensorRT 模型連線公共預覽版：Hugging Face 檢查點到兩個命令中的本機 C++ 推理一文首先出現在 MarkTechPost 上。

items_ai.summary: Google has open-sourced SAM (Sovereign Agent Mesh) under Apache-2.0 — and it has nothing to do with Segment Anything. SAM is a zero-config, zero-trust P2P overlay that lets autonomous agents discover and call each other's MCP tools across cloud, on-prem, laptop and edge environments, without exposing a single internal endpoint to the public internet. Identity flows from OIDC into Biscuit capability tokens, so nodes authorize every request offline under a strict default-deny model. The post Meet SAM (Sovereign Agent Mesh): A Zero-Config, Zero-Trust P2P Network for AI Agents appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_ai.summary_zh: Google 在 Apache-2.0 下開源了 SAM（主權代理網格）——它與 Segment Anything 無關。 SAM 是一種零配置、零信任的 P2P 覆蓋層，允許自主代理跨雲、本地、膝上型電腦和邊緣環境發現並呼叫彼此的 MCP 工具，而無需將單個內部端點暴露到公共網際網路。身份從 OIDC 流入 Biscuit 功能令牌，因此節點在嚴格的預設拒絕模型下離線授權每個請求。認識 SAM（主權代理網格）：用於 AI 代理的零配置、零信任 P2P 網路首先出現在 MarkTechPost 上。

items_ai.summary: Cartesia has released Sonic-3.6, a streaming text-to-speech model built on state space models rather than transformers. It now ranks #1 on both Artificial Analysis speech leaderboards — 1,283 Elo on Provider Voice and 1,123 on Controlled Voice, the board that clones every model onto the same eight reference voices to isolate the synthesis engine. Cartesia states sub-90ms time-to-first-audio. items_ai.title: 地熱電廠導入5G AI-RAN專網，結合AI提升巡檢效率20%、夏季發電效率增5%
items_ai.summary: AI應用、資料中心與高科技製造持續增加用電需求，發展穩定的低碳電力成為國內推動能源轉型的重要課題，其中運用地熱發電是一個重要的低碳電力來源，位於新北市金山的四磺子坪及硫磺子兩座地熱發電廠近期匯入5G AI-RAN專網、Edge AI、AIoT與生成式AI維運等技術。地熱電廠匯入機器狗智慧巡檢、能源最佳化分析及生成式AI維運系統 ，巡檢效率提高逾20%，夏季發電效率提升5%以上，建立國內綠能發電智慧維運管理的應用案例。 這項計畫由臺灣大哥大與將捷集團旗下結元能源開發合作推動，在國發會「AI+產業智慧共創實證計畫－AI服務大平臺整合次世代通訊之生態共創服務計畫」支援之下進行，希望驗證AI結合5G通訊在綠能發電場域的應用成效，建立可複製的智慧能源維運模式。

items_ai.title: Nous Research Ships Bot Mode for Hermes Agent, Turning Agent Profiles Into a Roster of Named Bots
items_ai.summary: Nous Research has shipped Bot Mode for Hermes Agent, its MIT-licensed open source agent. Bot Mode replaces the single-agent session list with a roster of named bots. Each bot is a real Hermes profile, with its own chat, memory, skills, and pinned model. It is now bundled and default-on in Hermes Desktop. The post Nous Research Ships Bot Mode for Hermes Agent, Turning Agent Profiles Into a Roster of Named Bots appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_ai.summary_zh: Nous Research 已經為 Hermes Agent 提供了 Bot 模式，Hermes Agent 是其 MIT 許可的開源代理。機器人模式用指定機器人名冊取代單代理會話列表。每個機器人都是真正的 Hermes 個人資料，具有自己的聊天、記憶、技能和固定模型。它現在已捆綁並在 Hermes Desktop 中預設開啟。 Nous Research 為 Hermes Agent 提供 Bot 模式，將 Agent 配置檔案轉化為命名機器人名冊，該文章首先出現在 MarkTechPost 上。
